name: mape
description:
I want the evaluation metric to be MAPE 
which is mean absolute percentage error
understanding: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) measures the average magnitude of forecast errors as a percentage of the actual values. For each row, compute |actual - forecast| / |actual|, then average these values across all rows and express as a percentage. Rows where actual equals zero are excluded from the calculation to avoid division by zero. Formula: MAPE = (1/n) * Σ(|actual_i - forecast_i| / |actual_i|) * 100.
